# WS-00 — Repo skeleton, contracts, fixtures

Store root `$S` = `/cursor/stores/bc-5bc79926-909c-4cfb-aa62-24b3a44735e2`. Plan: `$S/docs/server-pipeline-build-plan.md` §6 WS-00. Every `[default chosen]` below is listed in `$S/internal/build/layout-decisions-contracts.md`; the cross-brief seams (`SD-nn`) are decided in `$S/internal/build/seam-decisions.md` and this brief is their authoritative carrier.

## 0. Card

- **WS-00 `skeleton-and-contracts`.** Goal: land the `server/` package skeleton, one typed contract package (pydantic v2 models + JSON Schema) for every artifact that crosses a workstream boundary, the golden fixtures behind `make validate`, and the CI jobs every later WS must keep green, so WS-01…WS-11 start in parallel against fixed names.
- Builder: Grok 4.7 (the coordinator may assign a stronger model; the brief is model-agnostic). Validator: a separate agent, never the builder.
- Inputs consumed: store docs, schemas, code and data listed in §1 (no upstream WS). Outputs produced: `server/contracts` (every WS), `server/common` interfaces (WS-01/03/12), `server/eval` vendored harness (WS-04/05/06/09/11), stage stubs + artifact names (WS-02…WS-10), `data/fixtures` + `make validate` (WS-04/05/06/09/11), CI jobs `contracts` and `fixtures` (all), `docs/components/_template.md` (all).
- Repo `huntertcarver/house-scanning-server`. Exception to the one-PR rule: three PRs, merged in order, so later WS can start after the first two: `ws-00/contracts`, `ws-00/skeleton`, `ws-00/fixtures`.
- WS-00 decides names, types, units, frames, file locations and gates. **It decides no algorithm** (§11).

- Repo access: Cursor's GitHub app installed on the repo, or the Mac-sync push path (`scripts/sync_breadth.sh`, plan §6 WS-00). Repo `main` has `pyproject.toml` (uv, ruff line length 120, target py312) and `.github/workflows/ci.yml` with green `lint` and `test` jobs (`$S/internal/smp/smp-architecture-review.md` §4). - Build machine: Python 3.12, `uv` (the version pinned by the repo's `ci.yml`), `p7zip-full`, `curl`, ≥ 10 GB free disk (ETH3D archives for three scenes), 4 CPU cores. No GPU, no Modal account, no API key.

## 3. Interfaces

### 3.1 Conventions (apply to every model)

- pydantic ≥ 2.7 `[default chosen]`. Base class `server.contracts._base.Strict`: `extra="forbid"`, `populate_by_name=True`, `serialize_by_alias=True`. `Loose` (`extra="allow"`) only where the JSON Schema allows extras: `Exif`, `ScaleExt`, every `ext` dict, `session.gates`, `conventions`, `provenance.producer.params`.
- Field names are the wire names verbatim, no alias layer `[default chosen]`: camelCase for everything the device sends or receives (packet, API, result); snake_case for internal files and rows (scene, verdict, labels, scale, jobs). One alias: `Object.class_` ↔ `class`.
- Type aliases (`server/contracts/_base.py`): `RelPath` = str `^(?!/)(?!.*\.\./).+$`; `Sha256Hex` = `^[0-9a-f]{64}$`; `IsoTime` = str with the packet schema's `isoTime` pattern (kept as string for byte-exact round trips); `Vec3`, `Point3` = 3 floats; `Point2` = 2 floats; `Mat4` = 16 floats **column-major** (`simd_float4x4`); `Intrinsics` = `[fx, fy, cx, cy]` px; `Span` = `[start, end]` with `start ≤ end`; `Box4` = `[u0, v0, u1, v1]` px.
- Units and frames vocabulary used in the tables: `m` metres, `ft` feet, `in` inches, `deg`, `rad`, `s_up` seconds of device uptime, `px` continuous pixels with (0,0) at the top-left corner of the top-left pixel, `g` = 9.80665 m/s². Frames: `arkit_world` (per epoch, +y up, origin at session start), `arkit_camera` (+x right, +y up, looks along −z), `device` (Core Motion), `colmap_model`, `scene` = `meter_anchored/v0` (origin on the ground under the meter, +y up, +z out of the meter wall, +x = y × z; `s` along the chain, m).
- Every JSON Schema in `server/contracts/schemas/` is draft 2020-12. Hand-written schemas are copied verbatim from the store (§5) and stay the source of truth; models derived from them must accept and reject exactly the same documents (§4 step 7). New models (result, api, jobs, scale) export their schema with `python -m server.contracts.export_schemas`.

Enums: `Tier = arkit_lidar|arkit|photo_only`; `TrackingState = normal|notAvailable|limited.initializing|limited.excessiveMotion|limited.insufficientFeatures|limited.relocalizing`; `FileRole = keyframe|depth|confidence|features|still|stream|truedepth|mesh|compat|other` (the Upload API's per-file role is exactly this set; **there is no `keyframe_image`**, §4 step 5).

`check_packet(pk: Packet, root: Path | None = None) -> ValidationReport` (`server/contracts/validation.py`, SD-14: `ValidationIssue {code: str; level: error|warning; pointer: str (RFC 6901 into packet.json); message: str; value?: Any}`; `ValidationReport {format: "hss-validation-report/v0"; packetId?, formatVersion?: str; tier?: Tier; stage: manifest|full; ok: bool; errors, warnings: list[ValidationIssue]; keyframes, stills, taps, epochs, files, filesHashed: int; maxTapReplayError?: float; imagesUsable: bool; imagesDecodable: int; timingsS: dict[str, float]}` with `to_api_error() -> ApiError`; WS-02 imports these, never a second report type; there is no `PacketReport`) adds the semantic checks that need no geometry with `stage: "manifest"` (mirrors `internal/packet-generator/packetgen/validate.py`): errors for a tap or still naming an unknown keyframe, a keyframe naming an unknown epoch, a close-up `still` that is not a still, a door view on an unknown frame or with a box outside its frame, a TrueDepth file not listed in `files`; warnings for non-increasing timestamps within an epoch, a close-up with the wrong purpose or no keyframe link, `arkitDistanceM` outside 0.3–3 m, head-on `viewAngleDeg` > 30° or oblique outside 15–50°, `meterIdentity.source == on_device_text` with no text, `doorOnMeterSide` true with no views, TrueDepth `relative` accuracy. With `root`, it also checks every listed file exists with the stated `bytes` and `sha256`. Tap-ray replay, depth sizes, stream headers, EXIF intrinsics are WS-02.

### 3.4 `server/contracts/verdict.py` — verdict v0 (`schemas/verdict.v0.schema.json`)

| Model | Fields | Units |
|---|---|---|
| `Verdict` | `format: "base-verdict/v0"`; `verdict_id: str`; `scene: {scene_id, site: str; sha256?, producer_path?: str; data?: real\|synthetic\|hybrid}`; `evaluator: {path: str; version?, rules_profile?, rules_sha256?, ground_rule?: str; auto_approve?: bool; runtime_s?, cost_usd?: float ≥0; ground_incidence_deg?: float}`; `site: {decision: pass\|manual_review\|reject; reasons: list[str]; chosen_candidate?: str\|None}`; `criteria: list[Criterion]`; `candidates?: list[Candidate]`; `views_needed: list[ViewNeeded]` | `rules_profile` ∈ `A, B, C, S, demo, public` (labels use `S`; C1 rules-3d calls it `strictest`: WS-09 maps to `S`) |
| `Criterion` | `id: str`; `scope: site\|candidate`; `candidate_id?: str`; `outcome: pass\|fail\|unsure`; `unsure_cause?: margin\|unobserved\|grazing\|unknown_attribute\|rule_requires_review\|generated_only\|not_evaluated`; `reason: str`; `measured: Measured\|None` (key required); `fact?: Fact`; `threshold: Threshold\|None` (key required); `margin_ft?: float\|None`; `margin_over_uncertainty?: float\|None`; `evidence?: {element_ids?, views?: list[str]; coverage?: observed\|partial\|unobserved\|not_applicable}`; `views_needed?: list[str]` | ids from the catalogue (format doc §5) |
| `Measured` | `value_ft: float`; `plus_minus_ft: float ≥0`; `subject?: str`; `element_ids?: list[str]`; `coverage: list[CoverageEvidence] (≥1)` | ft; bound, not σ |
| `Fact` | `value: str\|float\|bool\|None`; `clean: bool`; `raw?: str`; `coverage: list[CoverageEvidence] (≥1)` | unclean is never pass |
| `Threshold` | `value_ft: float`; `comparison: at_least\|at_most`; `review_value_ft?: float`; `rule_key?, source?: str`; `placeholder?: bool` | ft |
| `CoverageEvidence` | `region: {wall_id?: str; s_m?, height_m?, out_m?: Span; element_ids?, images?: list[str]; description?: str}`; `status: observed\|grazing\|partial\|unobserved\|generated`; `probes?: int ≥0`; `observed_share: float 0–1`; `seen_share?: float 0–1`; `views_min?: int ≥0`; `views_median: float ≥0`; `best_incidence_deg: float 0–90\|None`; `worst_best_incidence_deg?: float\|None`; `rule: {min_views: int ≥1; surface?: wall\|ground\|free; max_incidence_deg: float\|None; observed_share?: float; max_footprint_m?: float >0}`; `method?: str`; `sensitivity?: list[{max_incidence_deg: float; status; observed_share?, views_median?: float; rule_id?: str; max_footprint_m?: float}]` | region in `scene` m |
| `Candidate` | `id, wall_id: str`; `start_s_m: Span`; `outcome: pass\|fail\|unsure`; `failing?, unsure?: list[str]`; `footprint_m?: list[Point2]` | battery left edge `s`, m |
| `ViewNeeded` | `id: str`; `kind: band\|past_end\|close_up\|confirm_attribute\|region`; `band?: wall\|ground\|overhead\|facing`; `wall_id?: str`; `s_m?: Span`; `out_m?: float ≥0`; `side?: left\|right`; `target?: str`; `criteria: list[str]`; `why: str`; `view_angle_deg?: Span` (deg from the wall normal; lands by spec PR 2 of `internal/build/seam-decisions.md` §9, so the model accepts it only once the copied schema carries it) | no `prompt` here (§3.7); coverage grading, not geometry error, is the main cause of undecided outcomes (E2E report), so `wall_id` + `view_angle_deg` are what the device needs |

Contract validator (mirror `sceneio.verdict_contract_errors`): a `pass`/`fail` whose evidence is not all `observed`, or has `views_median < rule.min_views`, or `best_incidence_deg > rule.max_incidence_deg`, is invalid; a `pass` with neither `measured` nor `fact` is invalid.

### 3.5 `server/contracts/labels.py` — labels v0

`Labels {format: "base-labels/v0"; site: str; data: real|synthetic|hybrid; labeller, method: str; rules_profile?: str; site_decision?: pass|manual_review|reject|unknown; labels: list[Label]}`; `Label {id, criterion: str; scope: site|start_range; wall_id?: str; start_s_m?: Span; truth: pass|fail|borderline|not_pass|unknown; value_ft?: float; plus_minus_ft?: float ≥0; why: str}`. Validator: `start_range` labels need `wall_id` and `start_s_m`.

### 3.6 `server/contracts/scale.py` — scale block (A9 §9, plan §4)

`ScaleBlock {source: meter_model|lidar|arkit|none; model?: str; scale_factor?: float >0; rel_bound_95: float ≥0; status: verified|single_reference|unverified; estimates: list[ScaleEstimate]; conflict: bool}`; `ScaleEstimate {kind: str; contour?: cover|ring|base; rel_sd: float ≥0; used: bool; views?: int ≥0; residual_pct?: float; role?: primary|check; sku?: str; source?: str}`. `scale_factor` = multiplier from `colmap_model` units to metres (WS-06 reads it); `rel_bound_95` is a ratio (posterior 95 % half-width × 1.1); readers apply `plus_minus = shape_bound + rel_bound_95 × distance from the meter` (m). Recommended `kind` vocabulary `[default chosen]`: `meter_model, meter_generic, arkit_poses, lidar, door_sku, garage_door_sku, siding, brick, footprint, truedepth`. Home `[default chosen]`, aligned with the WS-06/WS-09 briefs: WS-05 writes `scale/scale.json`; WS-06 copies it next to `scene.json` and mirrors it verbatim at `provenance.producer.params.scale`; **no scene schema change** (the format doc says extras go in `producer.params`); `provenance.scale_source` uses the existing enum (`lidar`, `arkit_poses`, or `scale_reference` with `scale_reference_ids: []` for meter-model scale, since `meter_model` is not in the enum); the result copies `{source, status, relBound95}`.

### 3.7 `server/contracts/result.py` — device response (plan §5, `docs/hosted-architecture.md` §2.2 "Result")

Casing rule (SD-25, supersedes D-06): the whole device payload is camelCase, `outcome` included; the plan's §5 snake_case examples are fixed by spec PR. The only snake_case on the wire is the optional embedded `verdict` (a verbatim verdict v0 document). The model and its exported schema live here only (`server/contracts/schemas/result.v0.schema.json`); WS-10 imports them and keeps no second schema (SD-26).

| Model | Fields | Notes |
|---|---|---|
| `ResultResponse` | `runId: str\|None`; `status: CaptureStatus`; `site?: {decision: pass\|manual_review\|reject; reasons: list[str]; profile: A\|B\|C\|S}`; `scale?: {source, status, relBound95: float}` (from `ScaleBlock`); `criteria?: list[{id: str; outcome: pass\|fail\|unsure; unsureCause?: str; measuredFt?, plusMinusFt?, thresholdFt?: float; coverage?: observed\|grazing\|partial\|unobserved\|generated}]`; `viewsNeeded: list[ViewNeededDevice]`; `memberActions: list[retake_meter_closeups\|truedepth_meter_scan]`; `meter?: MeterBlock`; `verdict?: Verdict`; `verdictUrl?: str`; `previewUrl?: str`; `reviewUrl?: str`; `outcome: Outcome\|None` | `outcome` is null while `status ∈ uploading, awaiting_files, processing`; `verdictUrl` signed 15 min → the verdict v0 file; `previewUrl` signed decimated PLY; `verdict` (verdict v0 verbatim, WS-14's request) is optional and omitted by default `[default chosen]`; `viewsNeeded` and `outcome.viewsNeeded` are the same objects |
| `MeterBlock` | `status: auto_filled\|prefill_confirm\|unreadable\|not_captured`; `value: str\|None`; `candidates: list[str] (≤3)`; `barcodeConfirmed, readersAgree, clean: bool`; `evidence?: {image: str; boxPx: Box4\|None}` | WS-10's meter block from WS-08 facts; never auto-filled on reader agreement alone |
| `Outcome` | `kind: eligible\|needs_more_photos\|not_eligible\|manual_review`; `profile: A\|B\|C\|S`; `message: str`; `arkitEpoch?: str`; `frameToArkit?: Mat4`; `recommendedPlacement?: RecommendedPlacement`; `cableRoutePolylineArkit?: list[Vec3]`; `viewsNeeded: list[ViewNeededDevice]`; `reasons: list[RejectReason]` | `eligible` = `site.decision == pass`; `needs_more_photos` = `manual_review` with non-empty `viewsNeeded`; `not_eligible` = `reject` only when `SHOW_REJECT_TO_HOMEOWNER=true`, else `manual_review` with a review `message`; `frameToArkit` = inverse `frame.from_source` for `arkitEpoch` |
| `RecommendedPlacement` | `wallId: str`; `startSM: float`; `footprintM: {w, h, d: float}`; `boxSceneM: {centerM: Point3; sizeM: [w, h, d]; yawDeg: float}`; `boxArkitWorld?: {pose: Mat4; size: [w, h, d]}`; `confidence: float 0–1`; `profile: A\|B\|C\|S` | `startSM` = battery left edge `s` (scene, m); `boxArkitWorld.pose` = box-to-`arkit_world`, column-major, box +x along the wall left→right seen from outside, +y up; null in the photo flow without poses |
| `ViewNeededDevice` | the verdict `ViewNeeded` fields in camelCase (`id, kind, band, wallId, sM, outM, side, target, criteria, why, viewingAngleDeg?: [min, max]`) `+ promptId: str`; `prompt: {title: str; body: str}`; `targetRegionArkit?: {surface: wall\|ground\|free; polygon: list[Vec3] (≥3)}`; `suggestedCameraPoseArkit?: Mat4`; `referenceCrop?: {image: str; boxPx: Box4}` | customer-safe copy from WS-14's catalogue (`promptId` selects the entry, WS-10 renders `title`/`body`); polygon and camera pose in `arkit_world` m; `referenceCrop` is the photo-flow fallback; `viewingAngleDeg` = the verdict's `view_angle_deg`, or WS-10's derivation (`band: wall` → `[0, 30]`, `ground` → `[20, 60]`) while the spec PR is pending (SD-27) |
| `RejectReason` | `criterion: str`; `measuredFt?, plusMinusFt?, thresholdFt?: float`; `comparison?: at_least\|at_most`; `text: str`; `evidence: {images: list[str]; boxesPx: list[Box4]}` | never raw Base prompt text |

Settled here (SD-26/27): `promptId` + `prompt {title, body}` (not a bare string), `targetRegionArkit` keyed by `surface` (not `kind`), `referenceCrop {image, boxPx}` (not `reference_image {image_id, crop_px}`), `verdict` embedded only on request. WS-10 and WS-14 rename their `outcome` fields to this table.

### 3.8 `server/contracts/api.py` — ingest API v1 bodies (`docs/hosted-architecture.md` §2.2, spec Appendix D)

Base path `/v1`. Headers: `Authorization: Bearer <token>` on every call; `Idempotency-Key` on create, finalize, amendments; `X-Packet-Sha256` and optional `Content-Encoding: gzip` on finalize.

| Model | Fields | Route |
|---|---|---|
| `CreateCaptureRequest` | `packetId: str (≥8)`; `formatVersion: str`; `tier: Tier`; `flow: guided\|photo`; `device: {model, systemVersion, appVersion: str}`; `orderRef?: str`; `expected?: {keyframes?, stills?: int ≥0}` | `POST /captures` → 201 `CreateCaptureResponse`; same key + same body → 200 same body; same key + different body → 409 `idempotency_conflict` |
| `CreateCaptureResponse` | `captureId: str`; `status: CaptureStatus`; `upload: UploadLimits`; `eventsUrl: str`; `finalizeBy: IsoTime` | `captureId = "cap_" + ULID` `[default chosen]`; `finalizeBy` = created + 24 h |
| `UploadLimits` | `maxSinglePutBytes: int = 16777216`; `partBytes: int = 8388608`; `urlTtlS: int = 3600`; `maxFiles: int = 2000`; `maxBatch: int = 50` | |
| `RegisterFilesRequest` | `files: list[RegisterFile] (1–50)` | `POST /captures/{id}/files` → 200 |
| `RegisterFile` | `path: RelPath`; `bytes: int ≥0`; `sha256: Sha256Hex`; `md5: str` (base64 of 16 bytes); `role: FileRole`; `contentType: str`; `meta?: {keyframe: Keyframe} \| {still: Still} \| {trueDepthFrame: TrueDepthFrame}` | re-registering a committed path with another `sha256` → 409 `sha256_conflict` |
| `RegisterFilesResponse` | `files: list[{path: str; state: pending\|committed; upload?: UploadTarget}]` | object key `captures/{captureId}/{path}` |
| `UploadTarget` | `method: PUT\|MULTIPART`; `url?: str`; `headers?: {Content-Type: str, Content-MD5: str}`; `expiresAt?: IsoTime`; `uploadId?: str`; `parts?: list[{n: int ≥1; url: str}]`; `completeUrl?: str` | MULTIPART when `bytes > maxSinglePutBytes` |
| `CommitRequest` / `CommitResponse` | `files: list[{path: RelPath; sha256: Sha256Hex}] (1–50)` / `committed, notFound, mismatch: list[str]` | `POST /captures/{id}/files:commit`; repeat commits are no-ops |
| `CompleteMultipartRequest` | `path: RelPath`; `uploadId: str`; `parts: list[{n: int; etag: str}]` → `{path, state}` | `POST /captures/{id}/files:complete` |
| `FinalizeResponse` | `status: awaiting_files\|processing`; `missing: list[str]`; `runId: str`; `etaS: int ≥0` | `POST /captures/{id}/finalize`, body = `packet.json` → 202; same packet sha → same run; different sha → 409 `packet_sha_conflict`; spec §6 failures → 422 `ApiError` |
| `ApiError` | `errors: list[{code: str; pointer: str; message: str}]` (= `ValidationIssue` without `level`/`value`, §3.2) | `pointer` is a JSON pointer into the request; codes: `idempotency_conflict, sha256_conflict, packet_sha_conflict, role_unknown, schema, tier_rule, format_version_unsupported, file_missing, sha256_mismatch, depth_size, tap_replay, stream_header, capture_expired, unauthorized` (WS-01/02 may add; never `unsupported_format_version`) |
| `EventsResponse` / `Event` | `status: CaptureStatus; next: int; events: list[Event]` / `seq: int ≥1; type: EventType; at: IsoTime; data: dict` | `GET /captures/{id}/events?after=<seq>&wait=<s ≤25>`; `next` = the last returned `seq` (or `after`); `EventType` (10) = `files_committed\|hint\|capture_check\|stage\|verdict_ready\|retake_request\|review_started\|review_completed\|failed\|confirmation`; typed `data` (camelCase, SD-19): `FilesCommittedData {paths: list[str], committed: int, listed?: int}`, `HintData {code: HintCode, message, retake?, promptId?, frames?: list[str], confirm?: {imageId: str, fieldId: meter_number\|panel_brand\|main_breaker_amps, mode: pick\|type\|none, candidates: list[str] (≤3), preselected?: str, allowNone: bool}}` (`confirm` only with code `meter_number_confirm`, SD-51), `CaptureCheckData {complete: bool, missing: list[CaptureCheckCode], meterRead?: ok\|unreadable\|pending\|absent, prompts?: list[str]}`, `StageData {stage: StageName, status: StageStatus, attempt: int, runId, gpu?, durationS?, errorCode?}`, `VerdictReadyData {runId, kind: Outcome.kind}`, `RetakeRequestData {runId, viewsNeeded: list[str], memberActions: list[str]}`, `FailedData {code, message, next: manual_review\|none}`, `ConfirmationData {confirmationId, fieldId, imageId, kind, by: device\|reviewer}`. `verdict_ready` / `retake_request` are emitted by WS-10's `result` stage only |
| `ConfirmationRequest` / `ConfirmationResponse` | `fieldId: meter_number\|panel_brand\|main_breaker_amps; kind: confirmed\|corrected\|none; value?: str ^[A-Za-z0-9 ./-]{1,32}$ (required unless none); imageId: str; clientAt: IsoTime` / `confirmationId: str ("cfm_" + ULID); fieldId; imageId; kind; by: device\|reviewer; receivedAt: IsoTime; seq: int` | `POST /captures/{id}/confirmations` → 201; replay 200; a different answer → 409 `confirmation_conflict` for `by == device`, 201 superseding for `by == reviewer` (WS-01 derives `by` from the principal, SD-52); 409 `capture_closed`; 422 `value_required` / `image_unknown`; `GET /captures/{id}/confirmations` (SD-21; WS-14 files the spec PR) |
| `HealthResponse` | `status: ok\|degraded; storage, state: str; wifTokenExpiresAt?: IsoTime; version: str` (`GIT_SHA[:12]`) | `GET /v1/healthz`, no bearer (D-26, SD-36) |
| `CaptureStatusResponse` | `captureId, packetId: str`; `status: CaptureStatus`; `tier: Tier`; `flow`; `createdAt, finalizeBy: IsoTime`; `filesRegistered, filesCommitted: int`; `runId?: str` | `GET /captures/{id}` with `ETag` / `If-None-Match` |
| `AmendmentRequest` / `AmendmentResponse` | `amendmentId: str; answers: list[str]` / `amendmentId: str; pathPrefix: str` | `POST /captures/{id}/amendments`; `pathPrefix = "amendments/{amendmentId}/"` `[default chosen]`; the amendment packet carries `parentPacketId` |
| `DeviceRegisterRequest` | `token: str`; `platform: "ios"`; `bundleId?: str` | `POST /devices` |

`DELETE /captures/{id}` has no body (idempotent cancel + delete).

### 3.9 `server/contracts/jobs.py` — capture and run state (`docs/hosted-architecture.md` §1 row 5, plan §6 WS-03)

- `CaptureStatus = uploading|awaiting_files|processing|needs_views|complete|manual_review|failed|expired`. It is the single device-visible status (SD-18): WS-01 writes `uploading, awaiting_files, processing, expired, failed`; WS-03/WS-10 write `processing, complete, needs_views, manual_review, failed` through `StateStore.set_status`.
- `StageName` (11, SD-08) `= validate|poses|objects|reads|scale|dense|coverage|scene|objects_3d|criteria|result`; deps `poses, objects, reads ← validate` (parallel); `scale ← poses, reads`; `dense ← poses, scale`; `coverage ← dense`; `scene ← coverage, objects`; `objects_3d ← scene, objects`; `criteria ← scene, reads, objects_3d` (after `merge_objects`); `result ← criteria`; optional (failure degrades, never fails, the run): `objects, reads, objects_3d`. `EarlyJobName = early_reads|early_qa|capture_check`; `StageStatus = pending|running|done|failed|stale|skipped`; `Branch = lidar|image`; `FileState = pending|committed|mismatch`.
- Ids (SD-09): `captureId = "cap_" + ULID`; `run_id = "run_" + sha256(packet.json bytes as stored)[:16]` (same packet → same run; amendment runs hash the amendment packet); `confirmationId = "cfm_" + ULID`; events are keyed by `seq`.
- `CaptureRecord {capture_id, packet_id: str; parent_capture_id?: str; status: CaptureStatus; tier: Tier; flow: guided|photo; device_model: str; order_ref?: str; owner_principal: str; created_at, finalize_by: IsoTime; packet_sha256?: str; run_id?: str}`.
- `FileRecord {capture_id: str; path: RelPath; role: FileRole; bytes: int; sha256, md5, content_type: str; state: FileState; generation?: str; key?: str; committed_at?: IsoTime; meta?: dict}` (`generation` pins the object the pipeline reads; `key` = where the bytes are now, §3.9 prefixes). `CommittedFile {path: RelPath; role: FileRole; sha256: Sha256Hex; bytes: int; generation: str; key: str; meta?: dict}` is the WS-01 → WS-03 hook payload.
- `RunRecord {run_id, capture_id, packet_sha256: str; parent_run_id?: str; status: StageStatus; branch: Branch; flow: guided|photo; tier: Tier; profile_default: A|B|C|S; created_at, deadline_at: IsoTime; started_at?, finished_at?: IsoTime; artifacts: dict[str, str]; outcome_kind?: str; failure_code?: str; degraded: list[StageName] = []; spend_usd: dict[str, float] = {}}` (SD-17; coordinator-private control fields live in `blob:run_control:{run_id}`).
- `StageRecord {run_id: str; stage: StageName; status: StageStatus; attempt: int ≥1; failures: int = 0; respawns: int = 0; heartbeat: IsoTime; started_at?, finished_at?: IsoTime; gpu?: str; worker_call_id?: str; substep?: str; artifact_uri?: str; error?: str ("<code>: <message>"); error_code?: str; metrics?: dict[str, float]}`.
- `EventRecord {capture_id: str; seq: int; type: EventType; at: IsoTime; data: dict; run_id?: str; stage?: StageName}`.
- `StageContext {capture_id, run_id: str; stage: StageName; attempt: int; branch: Branch; flow: guided|photo; tier: Tier; work_dir: Path; inputs: dict[str, str]` (artifact key → local path; always `packet_dir` and `run_control`, plus `parent/<key>` on amendment runs)`; deadline_at: IsoTime; heartbeat: Callable[[str], None]; gpu: str | None; vlm_budget_usd: float; parent_run_id: str | None; models: dict | None; storage: Storage; state: StateStore; settings: Settings}`; `StageResult {artifacts: dict[str, str]; metrics: dict[str, float]; warnings: list[str]}`. No brief subclasses these (SD-17).

Storage keys (SD-01, one sub-folder per stage): signed PUTs target `uploads/{captureId}/{path}` (bucket `Delete` at 7 days on `uploads/` only); at acceptance + last commit WS-01 copies every listed file to `captures/{captureId}/{path}` (SD-30; pipeline stages read `captures/` only); finalize body `captures/{captureId}/packet.json`; amendments `captures/{captureId}/amendments/{amendmentId}/{path}`; transcoded stills `captures/{captureId}/normalized/stills/<id>.jpg`; early-worker blobs `captures/{captureId}/early/{reads/<stillId>.json, qa/<frameId>.json, meter_identity.json, capture_check.json}` (WS-08 writes `reads/` and `meter_identity.json` from `read_still`, WS-03 writes `qa/` and `capture_check.json`; WS-05 makes no vision call, SD-46); run artifacts `captures/{captureId}/runs/{runId}/<folder>/<file>`, never with attempt folders (attempts are local to `work_dir`; only a later successful attempt overwrites; `RunRecord.artifacts` maps the key below to the storage key):

| Artifact | Writer → readers | Contract |
|---|---|---|
| `packet/validation.json`, `packet/normalized.json`, `packet/capture_check.json` (+ stills under the capture prefix above) | WS-02 → WS-03/04/06/10 | `ValidationReport` (§3.2); `NormalizedPacket` (a valid v0.4 packet plus `ext.hss`, WS-02); `CaptureCheck` (WS-02) |
| `poses/cameras.json`, `poses/sparse.ply`, `poses/tracks.npz`, `poses/registration_report.json`, `poses/sparse/0/`, optional `poses/fragments/<k>/`, `poses/database.db` | WS-04 → WS-05/06/07 | cameras = `[{image, keyframe_id, pose (Mat4 camera-to-colmap_model), intrinsics, w, h}]` (the harness `score-cloud --cameras` JSON shape); COLMAP model; never `poses.json` / `registration.json` |
| `scale/scale.json` | WS-05 → WS-06/09/10 | `ScaleBlock` (§3.6) |
| `objects/objects.json` (2D, before `scene`) | WS-07 → WS-06 scene builder | `{"format": "hss-objects/v0", "objects": [{id, class, label?, confidence, views: [{image, box_px, score}], attrs?}], "ground_type"?: [{image, material: Region.material, confidence}]}` (per-frame ground votes; WS-06 takes the mode with ≥ 2 agreeing votes, else `unknown`, SD-47) |
| `objects/objects_3d.json` (after `scene`) | WS-07 → WS-06 `merge_objects(scene_path, objects_3d_path)` (called by WS-03, rewrites `scene/scene.json`, re-validated) → WS-09 | `{"format": "hss-objects-3d/v0", "objects": list[Object]}` in the scene frame with `source.views[]` |
| `reads/reads.json` | WS-08 → WS-09/10 | `{"format": "base-reads/v0", "capture_id", "facts": list[Criterion] (scope site)}` |
| `dense/dense.ply`, `dense/flagged.ply`, `dense/depth/<keyframeId>.npz`, `dense/dense_report.json`; `coverage/coverage.npz`, `coverage/bands.json`, `coverage/points.ply`, `coverage/scene_draft.json`, `coverage/coverage_report.json` | WS-06 → WS-06 (next stage) | stage-internal shapes per the WS-06 brief (SD-05) |
| `scene/scene.json` + copies of every referenced asset (`coverage.npz`, `points.ply`, `dense.ply`, `sparse.ply`, `scale.json`), `scene/build_report.json`, `scene/coverage_topdown.png`, optional `scene/preview.ply` | WS-06 → WS-07/09/10/11 | scene v0 (assets relative to `scene.json`) |
| `verdicts/verdict.{A,B,C,S}.json`, `verdicts/criteria_report.json`, `verdicts/placement.<profile>.json` (optional), sidecars `verdicts/{c1.<p>.raw,c1.<p>.chain,c2.sweep,c3.facts,c3.judge}.json` | WS-09 → WS-10/11 | verdict v0, one per profile (`evaluator.path = C1-rules-3d+hs11-chain` when the hybrid ran, SD-48/55) |
| `result/result.json`, `result/result.internal.json`, `result/review.html`, `result/preview.ply` | WS-10 → WS-01 `/result`, reviewer | `ResultResponse` without signed URLs; the internal file carries the true decision and is never served to the device |
| `run/timings.json`, `run/cost.json`, `run/stages.json` | WS-03 → WS-11/12 | per-stage `started_at, finished_at, duration_s, attempt, gpu, enter_s`; `spend_usd` buckets; `list[StageRecord]` |

### 3.10 `server/common` — interfaces the infra workstreams implement

```python
class Storage(Protocol):                      # server/common/storage.py
    def put_bytes(self, key: str, data: bytes, content_type: str) -> None: ...
    def get_bytes(self, key: str) -> bytes: ...
    def exists(self, key: str) -> bool: ...
    def head(self, key: str) -> ObjectMeta: ...          # bytes, md5_b64, generation, content_type
    def signed_put_url(self, key: str, content_type: str, md5_b64: str, ttl_s: int) -> SignedUrl: ...
    def signed_get_url(self, key: str, ttl_s: int) -> str: ...
    def list_prefix(self, prefix: str) -> list[str]: ...
    def delete_prefix(self, prefix: str) -> int: ...
    def copy(self, src: str, dst: str, *, if_generation_match: str | None = None) -> ObjectMeta: ...   # SD-16 (WS-01 promotion)
    def delete(self, key: str) -> bool: ...
    def initiate_multipart(self, key: str, content_type: str) -> str: ...
    def signed_part_url(self, key: str, upload_id: str, part_number: int, ttl_s: int) -> SignedUrl: ...
    def complete_multipart(self, key: str, upload_id: str, parts: list[tuple[int, str]]) -> ObjectMeta: ...
    def abort_multipart(self, key: str, upload_id: str) -> None: ...
# ObjectMeta {bytes, md5_b64: str | None, generation: str, content_type}; SignedUrl {url, headers, expires_at}
```

`class StateStore(Protocol)` (`server/common/state.py`) is the one state protocol (SD-15); no brief subclasses it. Methods, grouped by writer:
- captures and files (WS-01 writes; `set_status` also WS-03/WS-10): `get_capture(capture_id) -> CaptureRecord | None`, `put_capture(rec)`, `set_status(capture_id, status: CaptureStatus)`, `list_open_captures() -> list[CaptureRecord]` (status in `uploading, awaiting_files`), `delete_capture(capture_id)` (keeps `tomb:{id}`), `upsert_file(rec)`, `get_file(capture_id, path) -> FileRecord | None`, `files(capture_id) -> list[FileRecord]`;
- events (any writer; `seq` strictly increasing per capture): `append_event(capture_id, type: EventType, data: dict, *, run_id=None, stage=None) -> EventRecord`, `events_after(capture_id, seq, limit=100) -> list[EventRecord]`;
- runs and stages (WS-03's coordinator writes transitions): `put_run(rec)`, `get_run(run_id)`, `runs_for_capture(capture_id) -> list[RunRecord]`, `list_runs(*, status: set[StageStatus], started_before: datetime | None = None)`, `upsert_stage(rec)`, `get_stage(run_id, stage)`, `stages(run_id) -> list[StageRecord]`, `heartbeat(run_id, stage, call_id, substep, at) -> bool` (False = superseded), `stale_stages(older_than_s) -> list[StageRecord]`;
- generic kv, blobs, spend: `put_if_absent(key, value: dict) -> bool` (CAS; `modal.Dict.put(skip_if_exists=True)`), `get_kv`, `put_kv`, `delete_kv`, `put_blob(key, value)`, `get_blob`, `list_blobs(prefix)`, `delete_blob`, `add_spend(scope, usd) -> float` (scopes `total`, `day:YYYY-MM-DD`, `gpu:day:YYYY-MM-DD`), `get_spend(scope) -> float`.

Backends live in `server/common/backends/` (SD-15/16): WS-00 ships `storage_local.py` (`LocalFsStorage(root: Path)`, signed URLs are `file://` paths) and `state_memory.py` (`MemoryState()`), plus `resolve_storage(settings) -> Storage` / `resolve_state(settings) -> StateStore` factories and `server/common/tests/test_storage_contract.py` / `test_state_contract.py`; WS-01 adds `storage_gcs.py`, `storage_r2.py`, `storage_volume.py`, `gcp_auth.py`, `state_modal_dict.py` (one `modal.Dict` named `STATE_DICT_NAME`; key prefixes `capture: capturex: file: files: idem: amend: confirm: device: tomb: open:` for WS-01 records and `run: runs_by_capture: stage: event: blob: spend:` for WS-03's) by additive commits; `state_postgres.py` is WS-12's at migration. Every backend must pass both contract tests.

`server/common/config.py`: `Settings(BaseSettings)` with `load() -> Settings` as the one factory; env names only; required ones fail fast at construction (SD-12). Naming scheme (SD-11): platform and shared names are bare and defined only here; every per-area knob is `HSS_<AREA>_*` (AREA ∈ `INGEST, AUTH, ORCH, PIPELINE, API, POSES, SCALE, DENSE, COVERAGE, SCENE, OBJECTS, READS, CRITERIA, RESULT, EVAL`) and is declared in the owning brief. Platform: `SMP_PRODUCT_ID` (`house-scanning`), `SMP_ENVIRONMENT` (`dev|prod`), `SMP_SERVICE_NAME` (`capture-api|early-worker|pipeline|sweeper`), `STORAGE_BACKEND` (`local|gcs|r2|volume`, default `local`), `STATE_BACKEND` (`memory|modal_dict|postgres`, default `memory`), `STATE_DICT_NAME` (`hss-<env>-state`), `MODAL_APP_NAME` (`house-scanning`; the deployed app that `Function.from_name`/`Cls.from_name` lookups target), `GCP_PROJECT_ID`, `GCS_BUCKET`, `GCP_RUNTIME_SA_EMAIL`, `GCP_WIF_AUDIENCE`, `GCP_AUTH_MODE` (`wif|adc_impersonate|sa_key`), `VOLUME_ROOT`, `CAPTURE_API_PUBLIC_URL`, `R2_ACCOUNT_ID`, `R2_BUCKET`, `R2_ACCESS_KEY_ID`, `R2_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY`, `OPENAI_API_KEY`, `XAI_API_KEY`, `CAPTURE_API_TOKENS`, `UPLOAD_URL_HMAC_SECRET`, `WEBHOOK_HMAC_SECRET`, `BASE_WEBHOOK_URL`, `DATABASE_URL`, `APNS_KEY_P8`, `APNS_KEY_ID`, `APNS_TEAM_ID`, `GIT_SHA` (all secrets optional at import, required by the service that uses them); shared pipeline knobs `RULES_PROFILE_DEFAULT=C`, `SHOW_REJECT_TO_HOMEOWNER=false`, `GROUND_RULE_DEFAULT=angle80`, `HARD_STOP_MIN=20`, `CAPTURE_CHECK_TARGET_S=30`, `VISION_EXTERNAL_CALLS=on|off` (default `on` in dev, required in prod; `off` stops every external vision call); fixtures `FIXTURE_SOURCE` (default `$S/internal`), `FIXTURE_CACHE=.fixtures` `[default chosen]`. Values are never logged.

`server/common/logging.py`: one JSON line per event with the full key set (SD-13; WS-12's `telemetry.py` helpers build on it, never a second logger): `ts, level, event, msg, service.name, deployment.environment, product, git_sha, request_id, capture_id, run_id, stage, attempt, gpu, duration_ms, vlm_provider, vlm_model, tokens_in, tokens_out, vlm_cost_usd, disagreement, error_code` plus WS-01's HTTP fields (`http.method, http.route, http.status, principal, packet_id, amendment_id, storage_backend, state_backend`). `server/common/geometry.py` = `housepipe/geometry.py` (`from_column_major`, `column_major`, `pixel_ray_arkit`, `colmap_to_arkit_pose`, `project_arkit`). `server/contracts/capture_check.py` (SD-20): `CaptureCheckCode` (16) = `meter_close, meter_oblique, meter_closeups_in_session, meter_tap, door_view_meter_side, panel_close, panel_open, main_disconnect, keyframe_count, keyframe_cadence, tracking_quality, photo_count, wall_left_of_meter, wall_right_of_meter, ground_downward_left, ground_downward_right`; `HintCode` = those 16 + `frames_blurry, frames_dark, frames_overexposed, wall_gap_left, wall_gap_right, ground_not_seen_left, ground_not_seen_right` + WS-08's read-hint codes copied verbatim from its brief §3. No other spelling (`ground_downward_<wallId>`, `cc.*`, `too_few_keyframes`) exists.

### 3.11 `server/eval` — the vendored harness

Modules unchanged in behaviour: `frame, sceneio, chain, visibility, coverage, extract, taps, match, keydist, geomscore, verdictcheck, verdictscore, adapters/hs11, cli`, `eth3d/{build_gt,build_gt_c2,gt_common,recon_colmap,scene_from_recon,run_validation.sh}`, `vendor/{hs11_server,hs13_facade}`. Imports rewritten `evalharness.` → `server.eval.`; `server/eval/__init__.py` sets `SCHEMA_DIR = <repo>/server/contracts/schemas` and `VENDOR_DIR = <repo>/server/eval/vendor`. CLI (plan §6 WS-00): `python -m server.eval.cli {validate, score-geometry, score-cloud, query-coverage, audit-verdict, run-c1, score-verdicts}` with the flags of `internal/eval-harness/evalharness/cli.py`. Public Python API kept: `coverage.{CoverageQuery, query_region, build_grid, bands_from_grid, ground_sensitivity, INCIDENCE_LIMITS_DEG, GROUND_RULES, MIN_VIEWS}`, `geomscore.{score_scene, score_cloud}`, `verdictscore.{score, score_files}`, `sceneio.{validate, save_json, load_json, CoverageGrid, read_ply, write_ply}`, `extract.{extract_scene, ExtractParams, profile_entries}`, `adapters.hs11.run`.

### 3.12 Stage stub (every `server/<stage>/__init__.py`)

```python
from server.contracts.jobs import StageContext, StageResult

STAGE = "poses"  # the StageName this package implements

def run(ctx: StageContext) -> StageResult:
    raise NotImplementedError("WS-04 implements server.poses.run")
```

`server/objects/__init__.py` also exposes `run_3d(ctx: StageContext) -> StageResult` for the `objects_3d` stage (the coordinator dispatches by stage name, SD-24). `server/api/__init__.py` exposes `create_app() -> fastapi.FastAPI` raising `NotImplementedError` (WS-01); `server/orchestrator/__init__.py` exposes the stubs WS-03 fills (SD-23): `start_run(capture_id: str, packet_sha256: str, packet_uri: str, *, parent_run_id: str | None = None) -> RunRecord`, `prewarm(capture_id: str, *, tier: Tier, expected_keyframes: int | None = None) -> None`, `dispatch_early(capture_id: str, files: list[CommittedFile]) -> None`, `on_confirmation(capture_id: str, confirmation: ConfirmationRequest, confirmation_id: str, *, by: Literal["device", "reviewer"]) -> None`, `cancel_capture(capture_id: str) -> None`, `sweep() -> int`, and the re-export `validate_manifest` (from `server.packet.validate`, so `server.api` never imports `server.packet`). The coordinator calls `server.<stage>.run(ctx)` directly (no adapters); a stage may also expose a richer native entry point (`server.scale.run_scale`, `server.scene.build_scene`, `server.criteria.run.evaluate_scene`) that its own `run(ctx)` wraps.

## 4. Behaviour spec

1. **PR `ws-00/contracts`.** Create `server/contracts/` with `_base.py`, `packet.py`, `scene.py`, `verdict.py`, `labels.py`, `scale.py`, `result.py`, `api.py`, `jobs.py`, `export_schemas.py`, `cli.py`, `schemas/`, `tests/`. Copy the four hand-written schemas byte-identical (§5) and record each source path + sha256 in `server/contracts/schemas/SOURCES.md`. No edits to any copied schema: the scale block travels in `provenance.producer.params.scale` (§3.6).
2. `python -m server.contracts.export_schemas` writes `schemas/{result.v0,api.v1,jobs.v0,scale.v0}.schema.json` from `model_json_schema(mode="validation")` with sorted keys and 2-space indent; `--check` exits 1 when the committed files differ (CI runs `--check`).
3. `python -m server.contracts.cli check FILE...` dispatches on `format` (`house-capture-packet` → `Packet` + `check_packet`; `base-scene/v0`, `base-verdict/v0`, `base-labels/v0` → the model **and** `server.eval.sceneio.validate`); prints `ok   <path>` or `FAIL <path>` + errors; exit 1 on any failure. `check-packets PATH... [--files]` = `check_packet` with `root = manifest.parent` when `--files`.
4. Round-trip rule: `Model.model_validate(json) .model_dump(mode="json", by_alias=True, exclude_none=True)` reproduces the input after JSON canonicalisation (sorted keys, no whitespace) for every fixture in §6. Where a fixture carries `null` for an optional field (`depth: null`, `features: null`, `still: null`, `refusal: null`, `chosen_candidate: null`), keep it: those fields are `Optional[...] = None` with `exclude_none` disabled for them via `Field(json_schema_extra={"keep_null": True})` and a custom dump helper `dump_json(model)`.
5. **Role naming fix.** `FileRole` and `RegisterFile.role` accept exactly the ten spec values. `keyframe_image` (the example in `docs/hosted-architecture.md` §2.2) fails validation; WS-01 returns 422 `{"code": "role_unknown", "pointer": "/files/<i>/role"}`. No alias is accepted `[default chosen]`. Add `test_role_keyframe_image_rejected`. The hosted-architecture example is corrected by a spec PR (coordinator), not by this WS.
6. Tier rules (§3.2) are `@model_validator(mode="after")` on `Packet` and raise `ValueError` with the schema's wording (`"photo_only packets must have no keyframes"` etc.).
7. **Schema equivalence test** (`test_schema_equivalence.py`): for every fixture in §6 and every negative case in step 8, `jsonschema.Draft202012Validator(schema).is_valid(doc) == model_is_valid(doc)`. Any disagreement is a bug in the model, never in the schema.
8. Negative cases (each a small JSON edit of a fixture, in `server/contracts/tests/negatives/`): photo-only packet with one keyframe; arkit packet without `epochs`; `arkit_lidar` with `lidarAvailable: false`; arkit packet missing `scaleReference.ext.doorViews`; `files[].role: keyframe_image`; `sha256` of 63 chars; scene whose anchor is a `window`; scene with a chain wall id that does not exist; verdict `pass` on `grazing` evidence; verdict `pass` with `measured: null` and no `fact`; label of scope `start_range` without `start_s_m`; result with `outcome.kind: eligible` and no `recommendedPlacement`; `CreateCaptureRequest` with `flow: video`.
9. **PR `ws-00/skeleton`.** Vendor `server/eval` (§3.11) and run its tests (`test_verdictscore.py` needs nothing; `test_coverage_contract.py` needs the facade GT with PLYs: set its default GT path to `data/fixtures/scenes/eth3d-facade/gt-laser/scene.json` and skip when `laser.ply` is absent). Move housepipe files per §5 with a header comment `# vendored from internal/modal-pipeline/housepipe/<file> (store, 2026-09-26)`; rewrite `housepipe.` imports. Create the twelve stage packages with the stub of §3.12 and a `README.md` naming the owning WS, its brief, inputs and outputs (artifact names from §3.9). `server/modal_app.py` = the image definition, `app` (`modal.App("house-scanning")`) and `volume` from `internal/modal-pipeline/app.py` plus `smoke_cpu` only; `Pipeline` is not carried (WS-03 builds it on this `app`/`image` in `server/orchestrator/modal_functions.py`; WS-12 composes and deploys, SD-32). `import server.modal_app` must succeed without a Modal token.
10. Import rules (import-linter in `pyproject.toml`, run by the `contracts` CI job): `server.contracts` imports nothing from `server` except `server.contracts`; `server.common` imports only `server.contracts`; `server.eval` imports only `server.contracts`, `server.common`; stage packages (`packet, poses, scale, dense, coverage, scene, objects, reads, criteria, result`) import `server.contracts`, `server.common`, `server.eval` and never each other; `server.orchestrator` imports the stage packages' `run`; `server.api` imports `server.contracts`, `server.common`, `server.orchestrator`. Violations fail CI.
11. Makefile targets: `setup` (`uv sync --frozen`), `lint`, `test`, `schemas`, `hygiene`, `fixtures`, `gt`, `validate`, `validate-full`, `ci` (= `lint test schemas hygiene validate`). Exact commands in §7.
12. `scripts/check_repo_hygiene.py`: fails on any tracked file > 5,000,000 bytes; on tracked paths matching the deny-list `SSR_Prompts.md`, `ssr-quick-reference-notion.md`, `meter_numbers_hand.csv`, `hand_numbers_raw.txt`, `*.tar`, `*.tar.part-*`, `*.7z`, `.env`, `*.p8`; on text matching `sk-[A-Za-z0-9]{20,}`, `xai-[A-Za-z0-9]{20,}`, `AKIA[0-9A-Z]{16}`, `-----BEGIN PRIVATE KEY`. Runs in the `contracts` job and as a pre-commit hook (`.pre-commit-config.yaml`).
13. **PR `ws-00/fixtures`.** `scripts/fetch_fixtures.py --source $FIXTURE_SOURCE --only small|large|all | --item <id> --cache .fixtures`: reads `data/fixtures/manifest.json` (`{"format": "hss-fixtures/v0", "items": [{id, kind, repo_path|null, cache_path, source, bytes, sha256, committed: bool, licence}]}`), copies missing items, joins split parts (`cat *.part-* > x.tar`), extracts each `packet_tar` into `.fixtures/packets/<house>/`, verifies sha256, never writes into `data/`. Packet folders resolve `packet.json` first (variant-less real sessions and `mini-arkit`), else `packet.<variant>.json` (packetgen houses); a folder never holds both, and `--variant` on a variant-less folder is an error (SD-44; `check-packets` and WS-11's replay use the same rule). Sources are store-relative paths or `gs://` URLs (WS-12 mirror later). `scripts/make_mini_packet.py --out data/fixtures/packets/mini-arkit/` writes `packet.json` (manifest id `mini-arkit`, `kind: packet_dir`, `committed: true`, SD-43) and builds the synthetic ARKit-with-meter-stills fixture of §6 deterministically (solid-colour 64×48 JPEGs, `features.bin` of `20·count` bytes, two-row gzip CSVs with the declared headers, `bytes`/`sha256` recomputed) from `example-packet.json` (SD-29).
14. `scripts/rebuild_gt.sh`: downloads the ETH3D archives for `facade`, `electro`, `delivery_area` (`dslr_scan_eval`, `dslr_occlusion`, `dslr_undistorted`; `curl -L -C -`), extracts with `7z x -y`, runs `python -m server.eval.eth3d.build_gt --data <eth3d>/facade --out .fixtures/gt/eth3d-facade` and `build_gt_c2 --seed data/fixtures/scenes/<site>/seed.json --data <eth3d>/<scene> --site <site> --out .fixtures/gt/<site>` for electro and delivery. Then diff each rebuilt `scene.json` against the committed one ignoring `provenance.runtime_s`: if `walls`, `chain`, `objects` or `coverage.bands` differ, keep the committed file (it carries the 18:24 UTC w2-window fix) and copy only `laser.ply` and `occluders.ply` next to it in `.fixtures/`; write the diff to the component page. Copy the two PLYs per site into the store at `$S/internal/eval-harness/results/<site>/gt-laser/` (they were VM-only) so `fetch_fixtures --only large` works for everyone.
15. `make validate` (committed fixtures only, < 60 s): `server.eval.cli validate` on every committed scene, verdict and labels file; `server.contracts.cli check-packets --no-files` on every committed packet manifest and example. `make validate-full` (after `make fixtures ONLY=all`): plus `check-packets --files` on each extracted tar variant, `score-geometry --gt GT --recon GT` self-check per site, and the reference-verdict regression (`score-verdicts` output equal to the committed `data/fixtures/reference-scores/<stem>.json` after dropping `labels_file`).
16. `docs/components/_template.md` sections: Purpose; Owner WS and brief; Inputs / outputs (artifact names); How to run on a fixture; How to test; Rebuild from scratch (no VM-only state); Last gate table (pasted); Known limits. Fill it in for WS-00.
17. Determinism: no randomness anywhere in WS-00 code; schema export and manifest are byte-stable; fixture sha256s are recorded once and only change with a documented rebuild.
18. Failure modes: missing store path → `fetch_fixtures` exits 2 with the missing item ids; sha256 mismatch → exit 3 and delete the bad cache file; `rebuild_gt` disk full or 7z missing → exit 4 with the command to install `p7zip-full`; ETH3D URL 4xx → exit 5 (network; retry later, do not swap the dataset).

| Packet manifests | `data/fixtures/packets/<house>/packet.<variant>.json` for the eight packetgen houses (five golden + `yt-0gotY_syWWU`, `yt-4h8kyjnPo9s`, `yt-5-M-7f35Tyg`) × `arkit-lidar, arkit-nonlidar, arkit-nonlidar-2018, pose-free`, plus `yt-12Ks1idWj40/packet.photo-only.json` | extracted from the tars | 50–400 KB each | yes | packet v0.4 schema on 33 real manifests (WS-02's gate); tiers `arkit_lidar`, `arkit`, `photo_only` |
| Example packets | `data/fixtures/packets/examples/{example-packet,example-packet-photo-only}.json` | `internal/packet-generator/schema/` | 11 KB, 2.4 KB | yes | Appendix B examples (arkit with taps + close-ups; photo-only) |
| Mini ARKit packet (SD-29) | `data/fixtures/packets/mini-arkit/` (`packet.json` + files) | built by `scripts/make_mini_packet.py` from `example-packet.json` | ≈ 60 KB | yes | the shared ARKit fixture with meter stills: 4 keyframes `k00001–k00004`, stills `s1` (`meter_close`) and `s2` (`meter_oblique`), the `meter` tap, one door view; `check-packets --files` passes; used by WS-01/02/03/05/07/08 |
| Packet tars | `.fixtures/packets/<house>.tar` (+ extracted `<house>/`) | `internal/data/packets/archives/`: `eth3d-facade.tar.part-00+01` (93 MB, 76 kf, laser-rendered LiDAR depth), `eth3d-electro.tar` (36 MB, 45 kf, LiDAR depth), `tt-barn.tar` (68 MB, 137 kf), `yt-Qm4b1cw8pV4.tar` (40 MB, 135 kf), `yt-LCPBf86oloE.tar` (38 MB, 153 kf), `yt-0gotY_syWWU.tar` (18 MB, 47 kf), `yt-4h8kyjnPo9s.tar` (19 MB), `yt-5-M-7f35Tyg.tar` (22 MB), `yt-12Ks1idWj40.tar` (4.4 MB, 6 stills, `photo_only`; the only store packet with stills, purposes `meter_surround`, `panel_surround`, `house_overview`; excluded from placement scoring and `e2e_packets`, D-22) | see left | no | file/sha256 checks; LiDAR branch = facade/electro `arkit-lidar` only (the other houses' `arkit-lidar` has `sceneDepthEnabled: false`); image branch = every `arkit-nonlidar`; photo flow = `pose-free` and `photo-only` |

All packets are `source.kind: synthetic` (never evidence); `_truth/` folders inside the tars are never read by pipeline code. No fixture contains a real meter number, a customer photo, or Base prompt text. Every golden house has `stills: null` (`internal/data/packets/index.json`), so the stills fixtures are `mini-arkit` and `yt-12Ks1idWj40` until WS-13 lands real houses.

## 7. Commands

```bash
# setup (CPU laptop, ~2 min)
uv sync --frozen && make lint && make test                     # pytest ≈ 90 s without PLYs
make schemas                                                   # export + drift check, < 10 s
make hygiene                                                   # size + deny-list + secret patterns, < 10 s
# fixtures
export FIXTURE_SOURCE=/cursor/stores/bc-5bc79926-909c-4cfb-aa62-24b3a44735e2/internal
make fixtures ONLY=small                                       # copies the committed set into place (no-op after PR 3)
make gt                                                        # ETH3D download ≈ 3.5 GB + build_gt ≈ 85 s + 48 s + 35 s
make fixtures ONLY=all                                         # nine tars (≈ 340 MB) + PLYs, sha256-verified, extracted
make fixtures ITEM=yt-12Ks1idWj40                              # one manifest item (WS-12 deploy verify uses this form)
make validate                                                  # committed fixtures, < 60 s, prints ok/FAIL per file
make validate-full                                             # + file checks on extracted tars + GT self-check, ≈ 6 min
uv run python -m server.eval.cli score-geometry --gt data/fixtures/scenes/eth3d-facade/gt-laser/scene.json \
  --recon data/fixtures/scenes/eth3d-facade/gt-laser/scene.json --out /tmp/self   # needs .fixtures PLYs, ≈ 60 s
uv run python -m server.contracts.cli check-packets data/fixtures/packets/*/packet.*.json --no-files
uv run lint-imports                                            # import rules
```

## 8. Done when

- `make ci` exits 0 on a clean checkout of `main` after PR 3; the CI jobs `lint`, `test`, `contracts`, `fixtures` are green.
- `uv run pytest -q` prints `N passed` with N ≥ 45 (≥ 13 contracts negatives, ≥ 6 round-trip suites, 3 harness tests without PLYs, storage/state contract tests, geometry agreement, stage stubs, import rules) and `4 skipped` at most (the PLY-dependent coverage tests when `.fixtures/` is absent).
- `make validate` prints `ok` for 3 GT scenes, 2 recon scenes, 11 verdicts, 29 labels files, 36 packet manifests (33 real + 2 examples + `mini-arkit`) and exits 0; `check-packets --files data/fixtures/packets/mini-arkit/packet.json` passes with 0 errors.
- `uv run python -m server.contracts.export_schemas --check` exits 0; `git status --porcelain` is empty afterwards.
- Negative: `printf '%s' '{"path":"keyframes/k1.jpg","bytes":1,"sha256":"'"$(printf 'a%.0s' {1..64})"'","role":"keyframe_image"}' | uv run python -c "import sys,json; from server.contracts.packet import FileEntry; FileEntry.model_validate(json.load(sys.stdin))"` raises `ValidationError` mentioning `role`.
- With `.fixtures/` populated: `score-geometry --gt GT --recon GT` on the facade reports `key_distances.overall.n == 55`, `median_in == 0`, `p90_in == 0`, `scale_error_pct == 0`; `score-verdicts --verdict data/fixtures/verdicts/eth3d-facade/gt.C1.g80.json --labels data/fixtures/labels/eth3d-facade.demo.labels.json --out /tmp/vs` prints `"unsafe_passes": 0` and `start_agreement: 1.0`, identical to `data/fixtures/reference-scores/eth3d-facade/verdictscores/gt.C1.g80__eth3d-facade.demo.labels.json` apart from `labels_file`.
- Every stage package has `__init__.py` with `run(ctx)` raising `NotImplementedError` and a `README.md` naming its WS, inputs and outputs; `import server.modal_app` succeeds without Modal credentials.
- `docs/components/ws-00-skeleton-and-contracts.md` exists with the rebuild commands and the GT diff note; every `[default chosen]` in this brief appears in `internal/build/layout-decisions-contracts.md`.
- Regression gate that must stay green from now on (every later PR): `make validate`, `make schemas`, `make hygiene`, `uv run lint-imports`, and `score-verdicts` on the reference verdicts reporting 0 unsafe passes.

## 9. Validator checklist

Run on a fresh clone without the builder's environment; file the report at `internal/build/validation/ws-00.md` (frontmatter per the store rule; sections: environment, commands run with exit codes, artifacts inspected, hand checks, verdict PASS/FAIL, defects).

1. `uv sync --frozen && make ci` → exit 0; paste the pytest summary line.
2. `uv run python -m server.contracts.export_schemas --check && git status --porcelain` → nothing printed.
3. Open `server/contracts/schemas/SOURCES.md`; recompute `sha256sum` of the four copied schemas and compare with the store originals (`$S/internal/eval-harness/schemas/*.json`, `$S/internal/packet-generator/schema/capture-packet.schema.json`); all four must be byte-identical.
4. Run the `keyframe_image` negative from §8; run three more negatives by hand: remove `epochs` from `data/fixtures/packets/eth3d-electro/packet.arkit-nonlidar.json`, set `lidarAvailable` false in `packet.arkit-lidar.json`, change a verdict `unsure` to `pass` on a `grazing` region; each must FAIL in `server.contracts.cli check`.
5. Sample by hand: open 3 packet manifests and confirm `files[].role` values ⊂ the ten spec values; open `data/fixtures/scenes/eth3d-facade/gt-laser/scene.json` and confirm `frame.anchor.element_id` names an object with `class: meter`; open 2 stage READMEs and confirm the artifact names match §3.9.
6. `git ls-files -z | xargs -0 du -b | sort -n | tail -5` → largest tracked file < 5,000,000 bytes; `rg -n "keyframe_image" server data` → only the negative test fixture and this fix's test.
7. `uv run lint-imports` → all contracts kept; add a temporary `from server.poses import run` inside `server/scale/__init__.py` and confirm it fails, then revert.
8. With the store mounted: `make fixtures ONLY=all` and `make validate-full` → exit 0; confirm `$S/internal/eval-harness/results/eth3d-facade/gt-laser/laser.ply` now exists (~25 MB).
9. Fail the WS if: any schema copy differs from the store original; any model accepts a document the JSON Schema rejects (or vice versa) on the fixtures or negatives; a tar, PLY or file > 5 MB is tracked; a stage package contains algorithm code beyond the moved housepipe files; a `[default chosen]` is missing from the layout-decisions file.

## 10. Constraints

- Vision models anywhere in this repo: GPT-5.5 and Grok 4.7 only (cheap tiers from OpenAI/xAI only), no Anthropic. WS-00 itself makes **no** model calls, uses no GPU and needs no key; VLM spend $0, Modal spend $0 (image builds are WS-12).
- Never commit: real meter numbers (the store's `internal/breadth/b2/labels/meter_numbers_hand.csv` and `inputs/hand_numbers_raw.txt` must never be synced), Base SSR prompt text (`SSR_Prompts.md`, the Notion digest), API keys or secret values (env names only), files over 5 MB (tars, PLYs, weights), customer photos. `make hygiene` enforces the mechanical part.
- No customer tools in any contract: no tape, no measured length field anywhere in `Packet`, `ScaleReference` or the API (v0.2's tape fields stay dead). `memberActions` can only be `retake_meter_closeups` or `truedepth_meter_scan`.
- Target device is the regular non-Pro iPhone: every model and fixture must work with `tier: arkit` and `photo_only`; LiDAR (`arkit_lidar`, `depth` files) is optional and first when present (`Branch = lidar|image`).
- Privacy: packets are personal data; fixtures here are public datasets and synthetic metadata only; `LocalFsStorage` roots default to a temp dir, never the repo.
- Store docs are read-only for the builder; inconsistencies go into the component page, not into the docs.

## 11. Out of scope and handoffs

WS-00 must **not** decide or implement: COLMAP/SfM settings and fragment policy (WS-04); scale estimation, meter-model reads, dimension table (WS-05, WS-13); dense fusion, coverage grid parameters, scene extraction (WS-06); detection cascade, VLM prompts, 3D placement (WS-07); read prompts and agreement policy (WS-08); criteria rules, thresholds, profiles, `criteria.yaml`, C2 placeholders (WS-09); result copy table, AR maths, reviewer view (WS-10); API handlers, signed URLs, storage/state backends (WS-01); retries, sweeper, prewarm, early workers (WS-03); replay client and gate thresholds (WS-11); Modal/GCP deploy, secrets, Dockerfile (WS-12); labels approval, real-house data, new packets (WS-13); spec upkeep, iOS defaults, prompt catalogue, iOS-facing `packetgen` CLI (WS-14). Contract changes after PR 1 go through a spec PR that edits the store doc first and then `server/contracts`; the WS-00 owner reviews them.
